description: Change of use from a dwellinghouse (C3) to a dual use of dwellinghouse (C3) and live work unit (sui generis).
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Existing Plans, Location/Site Plan, Planning Statement and Marketing Brochure (with plans) [received 26/11/2019]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The live-work/residential (sui generis/C3) use hereby permitted shall be carried on only by Mr Tom Barnes, those working directly with Mr Tom Barnes and by no other person or party. As soon as he/she/they vacate the premises, the use shall be discontinued and the property restored to sole C3 (residential) use and retained thereafter in perpetuity unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
